shapes.exact_lookup: one name-unique top declaration whose identifier-terms cover all query terms -> minimal single-seed packet (rank/key/kind/label/path/decl_range/FACT)
shapes.ambiguous_lookup: >1 seed shares the top label -> keep bounded candidates with distinct paths/locators + decl ranges; never pick a winner
shapes.relationship: intent callers|callees|related -> endpoints + evidence + via preserved
shapes.path_or_connector: intent paths -> bounded connector packet (<=2 routes, <=3 depth)
shapes.orientation: broad find with no unique exact match -> bounded seeds + local relations
shapes.test_or_verification: seed factors mark a test -> decl + candidate test decls
shapes.unknown: no declaration seeds / unsafe to classify -> conservative bounded packet
